title: Transmissibility of an undamped mount
caption: With ζ ≈ 0 the transmissibility is T = 1/|1 − r²|. The machine at 25 Hz on mounts with f_n = 5 Hz has r = 5, so T = 1/24 = 0.0417: only 4.2% of the force reaches the floor. Isolation (T < 1) begins only above r = √2 ≈ 1.41; near r = 1 the force is amplified without limit.
alt: Transmissibility against frequency ratio: very large near 1, crossing 1 at 1.41 and falling to 0.04 at a ratio of 5.
description: T = 1/|1 − r²| for an undamped isolator, r = f/f_n.
T = 1 at r = √2 ≈ 1.4142; below that the mount makes things worse.
At r = 1 the mount resonates and T is unbounded.
